newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Macedonia presses Bulgaria to complete rail link.
newsitem.headline: Macedonia presses Bulgaria to complete rail link.

text.p: Macedonia is pressing Bulgaria to complete a planned railway link between Sofia and Skopje and is seeking guarantees from the Bulgarian government that it will finish its section on time, Bulgarian officials said.
The link is part of a route from Turkey to the Bulgarian Black Sea ports of Varna and Bourgas via Bulgaria and Macedonia to Durres in Albania. Italy has said it will join the project.
Bulgaria has repeatedly said it will complete all construction work on its territory a month before its neighbours, officials said.

Earlier this year Bulgarian Transport Minister Stamen Stamenov said Sofia was ready to provide $10 million needed to build its sector, while Macedonia needed some $120 million and had slowed down work on the project.
But Skopje has found German investment and work is progressing, Bulgarian transport officials said after talks with the Macedonian side this week in Skopje.
Bulgaria has only to complete two km of the line from Sofia to the Gjueshevo checkpoint on the Macedonian border and 600 metres of a project to enlarge a 1.1 km long tunnel near the border.
